diagnosis: Sparse collection correctly removes a root-fixed literal's large watch while retaining an unswept prefix clause. A later ConflictAnalysis promotes that slot and kernel_unwatch_large wrongly asserts that the old watch must exist. GDB confirms literal 35 has value -1 and level 0; the ordinary kernel watch invariant already permits this absence.
fix: Match the existing watch invariant: remove an entry when present; permit absence only for a root-assigned literal. Non-root/unassigned missing watches remain assertion failures. Release behavior, formula, proof and action boundaries are unchanged. A six-variable microtest constructs the exact sparse-collect/decision/conflict-repair sequence in both watched-slot positions.
